name: LD-2406-XG-01
summary: A robot joint servo-drive board with RS485 communication. It accepts a 24–40 V supply and specifies 32 A maximum phase current, with overcurrent, undervoltage and overvoltage protection thresholds.

description.en: A robot joint servo-drive board with RS485 communication. It accepts a 24–40 V supply and specifies 32 A maximum phase current, with overcurrent, undervoltage and overvoltage protection thresholds.
